description: The file defines a class 'VacancyMenuConfigurator' responsible for configuring menu items related to job vacancies within the Recruitment module of the OrangeHRM system. It implements a 'configure' method that overrides the current screen to 'viewJobVacancy'.

classes.name: VacancyMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Configures recruitment menu items related to job vacancies.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the screen to 'viewJobVacancy' for the provided Screen object.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Implements the menu configuration logic by overriding the current screen to 'viewJobVacancy'.
